question: Gopal starts from his house towards West. After 11 minutes walking a distance of 30 metres, he turned towards right and walked 20 metres. He then turned left and moving a distance of 10 metres, turned to his left again and walked 40 metres. He now turns to the left and walks 5 metres. Finally he turns to his left. In which direction is he walking now?
solution:
We have drawn the figure according to the information given in the question,

Let the starting point be A and Ending point be B as shown:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7222c7bbc44dfbeef96467093cf386ece7a15c4eb482a8787e68cb1570158e43.png] 

Then, from B if Gopal turns left and started walking, he is moving in the north direction. 

Hence, **North **is the correct answer.
